d:
Presenting the electrifying "Junction Lo" 8K Video Song from the movie Aagadu. Starring Super Star Mahesh Babu and the stunning Shruti Haasan (Special Appearance). This high-energy mass number is sung by Shruti Haasan and Simha, with lyrics by Bhaskarabhatla and music composed by Thaman S.
Movie Details:
Movie: Aagadu
Starring: Super Star Mahesh Babu, Tamannaah Bhatia, Sonu Sood, Brahmanandam, Rajendra Prasad
Music Director: S. Thaman
Director: Sreenu Vaitla
Producer: 14 Reels Entertainment
Music Label: Lahari Music
